name: DIAN
body: One-year HSTS with includeSubDomains, and http goes to https. But the Spanish home page declares lang="en", and inner pages declare no language, so screen readers read Spanish with English rules.
lesson: Set lang="es" on the <html> tag of every page. Screen readers, translators, and search engines all read it.
summary: www.dian.gov.co scores 71 out of 100 (C). 1 check fails now, 32 are at risk, and 11 pass. Fix first: 84 images have no alt attribute.

fix.title: 84 images have no alt attribute
fix.fix: Describe informative images. Give decorative ones alt="".

fix.title: 3 cookies are sent without Secure, and 1 session cookie is readable by scripts
fix.evidence: Without Secure: f5_cspm, TS01fff35b, SearchSession. Without HttpOnly: SearchSession. A script injected into the page could steal the session. Set on /dian/Paginas/Decreto-1419-del-17-de-septiembre-de-2026.aspx, /Paginas/Inicio.aspx,…
fix.fix: Set Secure on every cookie, and HttpOnly plus SameSite=Lax on session cookies.

fix.title: 2 form controls have no label
fix.evidence: On /atencionciudadano/notificacion/Paginas/default.aspx. Screen readers announce them as an unnamed field.
fix.fix: Pair each control with <label for>, wrap it in a label, or add aria-label.

fix.title: 12 pages have no meta description
fix.evidence: /, /Paginas/Inicio.aspx, /atencionciudadano/portal_de_ninos/Videojuego_MisionC/Paginas/default.aspx, /Paginas/CalendarioCambiario.aspx and 8 more. Google and AI answers then write their own snippet from whatever text they find.
fix.fix: Write a 50 to 160 character description for each page that says what a reader gets.

fix.title: Referrer-Policy is not sent
fix.evidence: Browsers fall back to their default. An explicit policy keeps full URLs from leaking to other sites. Missing on all 19 pages analyzed.

fix.title: Permissions-Policy is not sent
fix.evidence: Embedded content can ask for the camera, microphone, or location. Missing on all 19 pages analyzed.

works.title: AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
HSTS is sent with a long max-age
The start page arrived in 183 ms
The start page sets a mobile viewport
The start page reads well without JavaScript
